Troubleshooting No. 2: No anti-squat function

Initial check
(See page FA-30)

Do TEMS indicator lights indicate as shown below on sudden acceleration?

engine

Yes → Road test again.

No ↓

Check throttle position sensor and engine ECU circuit.
Bad → Repair or replace.

OK ↓

Check speed sensor and circuit.
Bad → Repair or replace.

Try another TEMS computer.
